facts.statement: Pelecanimimus lived in Spain during the Early Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: from the Early Cretaceous of Spain

facts.statement: Armando Díaz Romeral discovered a Pelecanimimus skeleton at the Las Hoyas Unit 3 site in July 1993.
facts.quote: In July 1993 Armando Díaz Romeral discovered a theropod skeleton at the Las Hoyas Unit 3 site

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus polyodon was named and described in 1994 by a team including Bernardino Pérez-Moreno and José Luis Sanz.
facts.quote: In 1994 this was named and described by Bernardino Pérez Pérez-Moreno, José Luis Sanz, Angela Buscalioni, José Moratalla, Francisco Ortega and Diego Rasskin-Gutman as a new species: Pelecanimimus polyodon

facts.statement: The only known specimen is an articulated front half of a skeleton including the skull, jaws, neck vertebrae, most back vertebrae, ribs, sternum, pectoral girdle, and parts of the forelimbs.
facts.quote: The only known specimen consists of the articulated front half of a skeleton and includes the skull, lower jaws, all the neck vertebrae and most of the back vertebrae, ribs, sternum, the pectoral girdle, a complete right forelimb and most of the left forelimb

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus is notable for having more teeth than any other ornithomimosaur or theropod, most of which are toothless.
facts.quote: It is notable for possessing more teeth than any other member of the Ornithomimosauria (or any other theropod), most of which were toothless

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus was a small ornithomimosaur measuring about 1.9 to 2.5 meters in length and weighing 17 to 30 kilograms.
facts.quote: Pelecanimimus was a small ornithomimosaur, at about 1.9 - 2.5 m and 17 - 30 kg

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus had approximately 220 very small teeth in total, distributed across the premaxilla, maxilla, and dentary.
facts.quote: It had about 220 very small teeth in total, with seven premaxillary teeth, about thirty maxillary, and seventy-five in the dentary

facts.statement: The teeth of Pelecanimimus were heterodont, displaying two distinct basic forms.
facts.quote: The teeth were heterodont, showing two different basic forms

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus lacked interdental plates.
facts.quote: Interdental plates were lacking

facts.statement: It is debated whether the evolution of toothlessness in ornithomimosaurs resulted from progressive reduction or an exaptation process involving an increase in tooth number.
facts.quote: The phylogenetic hypothesis...supports an unexpected approach, involving exaptation, which might explain the evolutionary process towards the toothless condition in Ornithomimosauria

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus lived at the beginning of the Cretaceous period, about 125 million years ago, during the Barremian.
facts.quote: que vivió a principios del período Cretácico, hace algo más de 125millones de años, en el Barremiense

facts.statement: The only known specimen consists of an articulated front half of a skeleton including the skull, all neck vertebrae, most dorsal vertebrae, ribs, sternum, pectoral girdle, the complete right forelimb, and most of the left forelimb.
facts.quote: El único espécimen conocido consiste de la mitad delantera articulada de un esqueleto que incluye el cráneo, todas las vértebras del cuello y la mayor parte de las vértebras dorsales, costillas, esternón, la cintura pectoral, el miembro delantero derecho completo y la mayor parte del izquierdo

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus is the oldest known ornithomimosaur, measuring between 1.9 and 2.5 meters in length and weighing between 17 and 25 kilograms.
facts.quote: Pelecanimimus es el ornitomimosauriano más antiguo de los que se tenga noticia, siendo de pequeño tamaño, llegó a medir entre 1,9 a 2,5metros y de 17 a 25kilogramos.

facts.statement: The species is known from a single, partial skeleton that includes a well-preserved skull and numerous skin impressions.
facts.quote: Se conoce a partir de un único esqueleto que, aunque parcial, incluye un cráneo muy bien conservado y gran número de huellas de piel.

facts.statement: Its skull is long, narrow, and pointed, with a maximum length nearly 4.5 times its height, large eyes, and a crest on the back of the head.
facts.quote: El cráneo de Pelecanimimus es largo, estrecho y puntiagudo, con una longitud máxima de cerca de 4,5veces su altura máxima, de ojos muy grandes y una cresta en la parte posterior o nuca.

facts.statement: Unlike other ornithomimosaurians, Pelecanimimus had a toothed jaw with approximately 220 tiny teeth distributed across the premaxillae, maxillae, and dentary.
facts.quote: Pelecanimimus, a diferencia de otros ornitomimosaurianos, poseía una mandíbula dentada, con unos 220dientes minúsculos con 7premaxilares, alrededor de 30maxilares, y 75 en el dentario.

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus was determined to be omnivorous, capable of stripping foliage or hunting lizards.
facts.quote: Se ha determianado que Pelecanimimus era omnívoro, ya que podía arrancar follaje o cazar lagartijas.

facts.statement: All of its teeth were unserrated and had a narrow waist between them.
facts.quote: La totalidad de sus dientes no eran aserrados, y tenían una estrecha cintura entre ellos.

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus possessed a unique adaptation of having a large number of teeth interpreted as a functional counterpart to a beak's cutting edge.
facts.quote: Se ha determianado que Pelecanimimus era omnívoro, ya que podía arrancar follaje o cazar lagartijas.

facts.statement: Exceptional preservation at the Las Hoyas site revealed skin impressions around the throat, neck, shoulder, and upper arm, as well as a small skin or keratin crest on the back of the head.
facts.quote: Se encontraron impresiones de la piel de Pelecanimimus alrededor del esqueleto en la zona de la garganta, el cuello, el hombro y la parte superior del brazo, debido a las excepcionales condiciones de preservación del yacimiento de Las Hoyas, que también reveló la presencia de una pequeña cresta de la piel o de la queratina en la parte posterior de la cabeza.

facts.statement: A mysterious pouch similar to that of modern pelicans was found, though its function remains unknown.
facts.quote: Esa "bolsa misteriosa" era similar a la de los actuales pelícanos, pero su función es desconocida.

facts.statement: Because its remains were found along a lake, it is hypothesized that the animal used its pouch for fishing.
facts.quote: Debido a que sus restos han sido encontrados a lo largo de un lago, es de suponer que la usara para pescar.

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus is the first discovered ornithomimosaur where the hyoid apparatus, a group of specialized neck bones, has been preserved.
facts.quote: Pelecanimimus es también el primer ornitomimosauriano descubierto donde se ha preservado el aparato hioideo, un grupo de huesos especializados en el cuello.

facts.statement: Its habitat of temperate forests and humid climates allowed it to live among abundant food sources.
facts.quote: Su hábitat, de bosques templados y climas húmedos, le permitió vivir entre una exuberante alimentación.

facts.statement: Despite being an ornithomimosaur, it may have been one of the main predators in its area.
facts.quote: A pesar de ser un ornitomimosauriano, pudo ser uno de los principales depredadores de la zona.

facts.statement: The fossil-bearing levels belong to the finely laminated limestones of the Rambla de Las Cruces II unit, deposited during the Late Barremian.
facts.quote: Los niveles fosilíferos del yacimiento pertenecen a las calizas finamente laminadas de la unidad Rambla de Las Cruces II, segunda secuencia deposicional de la Formación Calizas de La Huérgina, depositada durante el Barremiense superior.

facts.statement: In July 1993, Armando Díaz Romeral discovered a theropod skeleton at the Unidad 3 site of Las Hoyas.
facts.quote: En julio de 1993 Armando Díaz Romeral descubrió un esqueleto de terópodo en el sitio de la Unidad3 de Las Hoyas.

facts.statement: In 1994, it was named and described by Bernardino Pérez Pérez-Moreno, José Luis Sanz, Angela Buscalioni, José Moratalla, Francisco Ortega, and Diego Rasskin-Gutman as the new species Pelecanimimus polyodon.
facts.quote: En 1994 esta fue nombrada y descrita por Bernardino Pérez Pérez-Moreno, José Luis Sanz, Angela Buscalioni, José Moratalla, Francisco Ortega y Diego Rasskin-Gutman como una nueva especie, Pelecanimimus polyodon.

facts.statement: The generic name derives from the Latin pelecanus, meaning "pelican," and mimus, meaning "mimic," referring to the long snout and throat pouch.
facts.quote: El nombre genérico se deriva del latín pelecanus, "pelícano" y mimus, "mímico", en referencia al largo hocico y la bolsa de la garganta.

facts.statement: The specific name refers to the large number of teeth possessed by this theropod and derives from the Greek polys, meaning "many," and odous, meaning "tooth."
facts.quote: El nombre específico es una referencia a la gran cantidad de dientes que posee este terópodo y se deriva del griego πολύς, polys, "muchos" y ὀδούς, odous, "diente".

facts.statement: The holotype specimen of Pelecanimimus, LH777, is currently located in the Museo Paleontológico de Castilla-La Mancha in Cuenca, Spain, and was recovered from lagerstätte beds.
facts.quote: El espécimen holotípico de Pelecanimimus, LH777, se encuentra actualmente en el Museo Paleontológico de Castilla-La Mancha, Cuenca, España, fue recuperado de lechos de lagerstätte.

facts.statement: A phylogenetic analysis by Makovicky et al. (2005) indicates that Pelecanimimus is the most primitive member of Ornithomimosauria, less derived than Harpymimus.
facts.quote: Un análisis filogenético realizado por Makovicky et al. (2005) indica que Pelecanimimus es el miembro más primitivo de Ornithomimosauria, menos derivado que Harpymimus.

facts.statement: The discovery of Pelecanimimus has played an important and remarkable role in understanding the evolution of Ornithomimosauria.
facts.quote: El descubrimiento de Pelecanimimus ha desempeñado un papel importante y asombroso en la comprensión de la evolución de Ornithomimosauria.

facts.statement: A phylogenetic hypothesis suggests an alternative evolutionary process based on a functional analysis of increasing the number of teeth.
facts.quote: La hipótesis filogenética sugiere un proceso evolutivo alternativo basado en un análisis funcional de aumentar el número de dientes.

facts.statement: Pelecanimimus lived during the Barremian stage, between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Barremian (125.77 to 121.4 million years ago)

facts.statement: A 2026 study by Calvo-Pérez & Cuesta reports evidence that the endocranial morphology of Pelecanimimus polyodon is similar to that of other ornithomimosaurs.
facts.quote: Calvo-Pérez & Cuesta (2026) study the neuroanatomy of the endocranial cavity of Pelecanimimus polyodon, and report evidence of similarity of endocranial morphology to those of other ornithomimosaurs.
